How to Apply
Applying to the graduate program in Biology is easier than you might think. Your first step is to contact "professors" you’d like to work with and explain why you are interested in their research program and what skills and passion you can bring to their lab. Once you’ve found a potential supervisor go online and complete the application to the Faculty of Graduate Studies. You will need contact information for three references, your transcripts, your statement of interest and your curriculum vitae.
Application Instructions
Users can access the online application by clicking Apply Now
The application takes approximately 30 minutes to complete
No student is made an offer of admission unless a faculty member first agrees to supervise that student. However, applicants may apply without having secured a supervisor in advance
The program usually admits students only once per year beginning September 1st.
Application status can be checked at any time in MyFile
Application Deadlines
Domestic student applications are accepted until May each year, but students are advised to apply as early as possible in order to improve chances of securing a supervisor and be eligible for entrance scholarships.
International student applications should be submitted by the middle of January, and applicants are advised to contact prospective supervisors as early as possible (even before submitting an application) since there are a very limited number of international positions available each year. Later applications could be accepted, but you should first contact biogpa@yorku.ca to see if there are still positions open.
Offers for major entrance scholarships are made in early-February.
Our program has a quota on the number of domestic and international MSc and PhD students that can be admitted. Apply early before these positions are filled.
Documents to be Uploaded Online using the Document Uploader
Supplementary Information Form
Referee List must include three (3) names and contact information to be added at the bottom of the Supplemental Information Form form. Your referees will then be emailed a link to upload their reference letter to support your Graduate Admission application.
Statement of Interest: a letter (500 words) addressed to the Program Admissions Committee, outlining your background in Biology and your reasons for wanting to pursue an advanced research degree.
Curriculum Vitae outlining your work experience, academic background, publications, awards, etc.
Transcripts from each post-secondary institution
Application Fee
Application fee (to accompany online Application for Graduate Admission)
is $140 Cdn, payable by Visa, Visa Debit, or MasterCard. The application fee is non-refundable
If you do not wish to submit your credit card online, or if you do not have a Visa or MasterCard, please contact York’s Office of Admissions at 416–736–5000
Your application will be processed upon receipt of your fee payment
Entrance Scholarships
Entrance scholarships may be offered to high calibre applicants on the recommendation of the Biology graduate program. No separate application for the scholarship is necessary.
CD Fowle Scholarship in Ecology (MSc or PhD, $7,000)
Enbridge Graduate Student Awards (MSc or Phd, $7,000)
Nestmann Scholarship (MSc or PhD, $7,000)
Carswell Science Scholarship (PhD, $10,000 1 year)
Vernon Oliver Stong (MSc or PhD, $10,000 1 year)
